calculation.description: For each tradable instrument, reverse the three-day return residual relative to the cross-sectional median return, scale by its trailing 20-day daily volatility, and activate only when the cross-sectional three-day dispersion exceeds its trailing 60-day median. All inputs use completed bars available at the signal date. Zero signals are retained outside the high-dispersion regime to preserve a complete artifact.

parameters.gate: current 3d cross-sectional return dispersion >= trailing 60d median

metrics.turnover: not estimated; binary regime gate with continuous cross-sectional scores

validation.regime_notes: Positive and above admission gates in full sample and recent subperiods: 2025-01 onward IC/ICIR 0.030163/0.084626; 2028 onward 0.030941/0.092534; 2029 onward 0.042878/0.125752; 2029-07 onward 0.043625/0.120077. Five-day decay remains positive but below the ICIR gate; ten-day predictive power is absent. Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
